title: A Hypnotist Told Her to Take Dance Classes | Break the Routine with Joanna Wargala
description:
Joanna Wargala won a cello competition at 16, studied in the UK and played first cello in a London orchestra, then spent 20 years in business, from her first company at 18 to precious metals. In 2016 she walked into a dance studio for the first time, and three months later she was competing in London. She tells Marius Iepure why she built Air Dance, now O-Dance, to bring top teachers to talented dancers from small towns who cannot afford to travel, and why online lessons should be "a continuation" of your lessons, never a substitute.

She opens up about the 3 a.m. wake-ups in Miami that pushed her to her limit, dancing the Pro-Am final at the Royal Albert Hall, and why dancers, not teachers, judges or organisers, are the most important people in DanceSport. Plus Dancecoin and the Audance token pegged to the dollar, why the dance world still runs on cash, the Air Dance Christmas Ball during Dancing Week in Poland, side businesses for dancers, and why the rumba walk is one figure she will never perfect.

An honest conversation about passion, vision and why it is never too late to start dancing.

Episode out now on YouTube.
